observation.command:
cd /workspace && cat >> config/runtime/base.vars <<'EOF'

# Studio job worker (graphile) local provisioning:
# the worker pool connects as sva_job_worker; POSTGRES_HOST points at the
# locally exposed postgres (host network), mirroring the container-name used
# in swarm/CI runs.
STUDIO_JOB_WORKER_DB_USER=sva_job_worker
STUDIO_JOB_WORKER_DB_PASSWORD=sva_job_worker_local_dev_password
POSTGRES_HOST=127.0.0.1
POSTGRES_PORT=5432
EOF
echo done
